observations: User-approved transparent UI method had an explicit dropdown collision correction. Text gap alone did not resolve it.

Actual clean-master zoom showed white icon color bleeding into the erased label region. Removing the icon from the fill context, then restoring original icon pixels removed the glow in both languages.
Protect source icon bounds and a visible gap in per-frame target geometry; separately inspect the neutral surface.

Raw Korean CTA ASR recovered the intended words, but candidate understanding initially hallucinated an app name. With +4dB voice only free-trial content was recovered; +6dB and +0.2s offset recovered all three Korean lines on the actual final candidate.
Reuse of master, trajectory and background needs new language fonts/voices/review. Six Korean model receipts total 0.88 credits; this is one source, not a universal fixed price.
limitations: Single source and same-agent sampled visual review.
Full music/FX fidelity and fine sync not independently established.
Background level can change slightly under peak control when foreground narration gain changes; do not call the mix lossless.
next_falsification: On another authorized filmed-phone source, check icon/surface color contamination and translated-label clearance across motion before general promotion.
